status_vocabulary.Demonstrated: Implemented and measured in the stated experimental scope.
status_vocabulary.Strong: Supported by multiple mechanisms or artifacts, but not yet a decisive end-to-end systems result.
status_vocabulary.Partial: A working component or useful evidence exists, with an important missing subproblem.
status_vocabulary.Emerging: An initial implementation or diagnostic exists, but the design is not yet stable or general.
status_vocabulary.Planned: Architecturally specified next work without a validating implementation.
status_vocabulary.Open: A required property remains unresolved and lacks adequate validation.

entries.pra_analogue: URI references and logical token positions
entries.headline_result: Named external objects and implicit prompt-head positions share one logical-memory interface.
entries.remaining_gap: No arbitrary-scale address-space or distributed namespace validation.

entries.pra_analogue: CPU or external source plus reference native K/V
entries.headline_result: Reference K/V can remain off device and preserve host-model-native representations.
entries.remaining_gap: Distributed storage, freshness, and production cache economics remain open.

entries.pra_analogue: Gists, hierarchy, source spans, and reference metadata
entries.headline_result: Compact metadata preserves identity, hierarchy, and routing state separately from native K/V payload.
entries.remaining_gap: Index maintenance and large-corpus update cost are not characterized.

entries.pra_analogue: Query facets and semantic root routing
entries.headline_result: Oracle root views reach 0.878/0.950 Top-4 on MuSiQue/2Wiki, versus 0.622/0.692 for cheap held-out selectors.
entries.remaining_gap: Executable facet selection and distractor calibration do not realize the oracle ceiling.

entries.pra_analogue: Native Q/K associative successor graph
entries.headline_result: Frozen native Q/K exposes strong 2Wiki evidence edges after entry, but topology changes with layer and chunk size.
entries.remaining_gap: Fine-grained natural edges and end-to-end entry remain unreliable.

entries.pra_analogue: Selected native K/V transfer from CPU to GPU
entries.headline_result: Selected layer-native K/V is transferred and consumed without replacing it by the routing gist.
entries.remaining_gap: Fused asynchronous serving transfer and concurrency are not demonstrated.

entries.pra_analogue: Bounded direct head plus active reference native K/V
entries.headline_result: Fixed-k routing reduces active fraction as logical memory grows while every native operation remains bounded.
entries.remaining_gap: Task quality and physical boundedness have not been validated from 32K to multi-million-token stores.

entries.pra_analogue: Separate encoding, search, and materialization units
entries.headline_result: Fine search nodes can remove useful native edges; controlled evidence-centered windows expose a separate disclosure frontier.
entries.remaining_gap: Physical window policy has not generalized across models, datasets, and production access patterns.

entries.pra_analogue: Logical interval gather across selected chunks
entries.headline_result: The controlled runtime gathers evidence-centered logical intervals across storage chunks and validates their causal output effect.
entries.remaining_gap: No fused asynchronous production gather under concurrent serving.

entries.pra_analogue: Union of overlapping logical K/V intervals
entries.headline_result: The controlled interval materializer unions overlapping logical regions while preserving token order and resource identity.
entries.remaining_gap: Concurrent cache coherence and production accounting remain untested.

entries.pra_analogue: Root route, associative discovery, then K/V disclosure
entries.headline_result: The frozen pipeline performs bounded discovery and exact selected-set K/V output validation.
entries.remaining_gap: Root competition and memory-use interference prevent a general demand-paging claim.

entries.pra_analogue: Bounded prompt head and adaptive working-set controller
entries.headline_result: Correctness-first head rollover, explicit effort budgets, and prototype LRU/LFU/hybrid cache policies exist.
entries.remaining_gap: No learned replacement policy, reuse-aware eviction, or serving pressure test.

entries.pra_analogue: Discover missing memory, materialize it, and continue
entries.headline_result: Discovery, physical materialization, and bounded monotonic retry are executable as separate stages.
entries.remaining_gap: No calibrated online fault detector or iterative decode-resume loop.

entries.pra_analogue: External source or CPU reference K/V to GPU active K/V
entries.headline_result: A basic host-resident to device-active native-K/V lifecycle is measured.
entries.remaining_gap: No distributed hierarchy, cache-coherence protocol, or production hit-rate study.

entries.pra_analogue: Bounded associative graph expansion
entries.headline_result: Synthetic indirect nodes and natural annotated successors can be recovered through memory-to-memory edges.
entries.remaining_gap: Natural benefits depend on entry, layer, granularity, and activation breadth.

entries.pra_analogue: Adaptive routing, K/B, layer, and materialization control
entries.headline_result: Validation-frozen effort profiles and an observable-only controller allocate bounded effort and record escalation traces.
entries.remaining_gap: Workload-level thrashing behavior and production stability remain untested.

entries.pra_analogue: Native K/V materialization window
entries.headline_result: Exact cores, local radii, complete facts, and whole parents define controlled and pretrained materialization frontiers.
entries.remaining_gap: The best physical window is model- and dataset-dependent; a learned general policy is absent.

entries.pra_analogue: Selected PRA consumer layers
entries.headline_result: Layer-selective consumption is executable and all-layer injection can be harmful in diagnostics.
entries.remaining_gap: Gate-3 placement is diagnostic and model/dataset specific, not a frozen deployment policy.

entries.pra_analogue: Facet controller and trained semantic router
entries.headline_result: Learned direct routing and observable-only effort selection work in scoped regimes, but cheap facet selection retains a large oracle gap.
entries.remaining_gap: Calibrated bounded control has not generalized across corpus scale, model families, and retrieval errors.

entries.pra_analogue: Approximately bounded active K/V as logical memory grows
entries.headline_result: Small controlled fixed-k curves show the intended direction, not arbitrary-scale boundedness.
entries.remaining_gap: Run matched 32K, 128K, 512K, 2M, and 8M+ logical-memory experiments with full systems accounting.
